sobre.label: About us
sobre.title: TM Mining International
sobre.experienceTitle: Over 20 years of experience in the mining and construction sectors.
sobre.experienceDesc: TM Mining International is dedicated to the international trade of industrial machinery for quarries, providing excavation, crushing and screening equipment to operators throughout Europe. We act as a link between manufacturers and sellers of used and new equipment and companies that need them, promoting the circulation of machines between markets and consolidating lasting business relationships with customers and international partners.
sobre.groupDesc1: We are part of the Seixas Pinto Group, with over two decades of activity in the mining and construction sectors in Portugal and Angola. The Group owns and operates more than ten quarries, complemented by its own civil construction companies, which gives us an in-depth and transversal knowledge of the entire value chain — from extraction to machine.
sobre.groupDesc2: It is this field experience, accumulated over more than twenty years, that we apply in the commercialization of thousands of equipment with producers worldwide.

values.innovationDesc: We constantly seek the best technological solutions for our customers.

servicos.service1Desc: We perform complete machine evaluation to increase availability and reduce unexpected downtime in operation.
servicos.service2Desc: Continuous monitoring of production indicators to improve efficiency, consumption and maintenance planning.
servicos.service3Desc: Maintenance plans tailored to the work cycle to extend the life of critical components.
servicos.service4Desc: We integrate technical and operational information to support faster and safer decisions in the field.
